metric_name: 能源使用效益目标设定与行动方案
query: 能源使用效益目标设定与行动方案 能源使用效益目标设定与行动方案 衡量企业是否建立了明确的能源使用效益目标（如节电量、能效提升百分比等），以及是否披露了实现上述目标的具体执行路径、技术手段及资源投入。重点考察目标的科学性（是否有时间表）、具体性（是否有量化值）及可落地性（是否有配套步骤）。 A. 目标设定得分 (权重 50%） 2分：披露了明确的量化目标、基准年及达标年份。 1分：仅有描述性或愿景式目标（如“努力节能”），无具体量效指标。 0分：未提及任何能源效益目标。 B. 执行方案得分 (权重 50%) 2分：详细披露了为实现目标所采取的技术改造、管理优化或可再生能源替代的具体步骤。 1分：仅笼统提及将采取措施，缺乏具体行动描述。 0分：无行动方案。 最终得分 = 0.5×目标设定得分+0.5×执行方案得分 能源效益目标 能效提升目标 节电目标 节能计划 能源管理体系 节能改造 可再生能源替代 能源绩效改进 ISO 50001 energy efficiency target energy intensity reduction electricity saving target energy conservation plan energy management system retrofit programme renewable energy substitution energy performance improvement ISO 50001 企业是否披露量化或定性的能源效益、节电或能效提升目标？ 量化目标的指标值、基准年与达标年份是什么？ 为实现目标采取了哪些技术改造、管理优化或可再生能源替代步骤？ 是否披露具体实施路径或资源投入？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '能源使用效益目标设定与行动方案'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否披露量化或定性的能源效益、节电或能效提升目标？ 量化目标的指标值、基准年与达标年份是什么？ 为实现目标采取了哪些技术改造、管理优化或可再生能源替代步骤？ 是否披露具体实施路径或资源投入？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有温室气体减排目标且无能源效益目标或行动；仅有能源消耗披露且无目标或行动；仅有历史节能绩效且无前瞻目标或行动。不得排除“努力节能”等定性目标、笼统执行意向，或未与目标显式绑定的具体能效措施：它们可分别支持目标设定或执行方案的低档/高档证据。区分：本指标分别评价能源效益目标和执行方案；温室气体减排目标不能自动替代能源效益目标。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: 為有效管理能源使用並提高能源效益,集團 各廠房正採取一系列措施,包括優化生產工 藝、改善生產流程及更換高效能設備等。於 回顧年內,集團整體能耗包括電力、蒸汽、 電油、柴油及天然氣等能源,比二零二零年 有所上升,導致總能耗按年上升約 17% 。以 每噸產品計算,本年的總能量消耗較去年只 錄得輕微上升。

results.section: 資源使用管理 RESOURCES CONSUMPTION MANAGEMENT / 電力與其他能源 Electricity and Other Energy Sources
results.text: To effectively manage energy use and improve energy efficiency, the Group's plants have adopted a series of initiatives, including optimizing production processes, improving production flow, and changing to high-efficiency equipment. During the year under review, the Group's overall energy consumption including electricity, steam, petrol, diesel and natural gas increased when compared to 2020. Therefore, the Group's total energy consumption increased by approximately 17% year-on-year. When measured by per tonne of products, the total energy consumption only slightly increased year-on-year.

results.section: 資源使用管理 RESOURCES CONSUMPTION MANAGEMENT / 電力與其他能源 Electricity and Other Energy Sources
results.text: We actively implement water conservation measures to improve efficiency in water usage. For instance, part of the steam condensed in Taixing plant was cooled by heat exchangers and then entered the water circulation system to reduce water usage. We have also installed water-saving devices in the living areas of our plants, and have assigned personnel to regularly inspect and monitor the use of related facilities. During the year under review, the Group's total water consumption decreased by 2% year-on-year.

results.text: As the Group's core business is in chemical manufacturing, we are committed to managing and minimizing the environmental impacts of our operations. Most of the plants of the Group have obtained ISO 14001 environmental management system certification, and some have also obtained ISO 50001 energy management system certification. To effectively manage the environmental performance of the Group's plants, the HSE Committee under the Board is responsible for formulating environmental strategies and monitoring related risks and effectiveness, and the HSE Department is responsible for day-to-day monitoring.
